description: Hi everyone! 👋 I’m Nidhin K, a Mechanical Engineering student from Kerala, India, interested in CAD, robotics, drones, AI, and space exploration. 🚀 I’m looking to build a collaborative team for the NASA Hackathon with skills in AI/ML, Python, web/app development, CAD/3D modelling, data analysis, UI/UX, and astronomy. Let’s combine our ideas, solve real-world challenges, and create innovative solutions together! 🌍✨
